[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.65) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세) + 373.04 지지선 확보 시 매수 진입 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($377.81) vs SMA5 ($372.38) / SMA20 ($367.22) / SMA50 ($351.73): Confirms short- to mid-term trend outperformance.
· Position vs SMA100 ($374.43) / SMA200 ($391.67): Mixed mid- to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (39.9%) + Current price range is a recovery phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.0→57.7) + Confirms exit from oversold and recovery into neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.0860→0.7703) + Diagnoses improving upward momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $367.22) + Normal bandwidth level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($373.04) + Basis (based on SMA200 and Pivot S1).
· Swing resistance ($384.04) + Potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout.
· 5-day high ($383.33) / low ($353.80), 20-day high ($386.83) / low ($345.88): Higher Low pattern continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.65) + Reduced confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + Buy entry condition met if $373.04 support holds.
